labs.pi_title: Co-Director; Ruth and Frank Stanton Research Professor of Urban Planning
labs.research_summary: A Harvard Graduate School of Design lab that connects faculty and students working on how places shape health and how to make them healthier.
labs.join_notes: The contact page says to write to Magda Maaoui, co-leader of the lab, with questions or to get involved. No jobs page or openings found.
